summary.text: Rob Bonta is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General, appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, seeking a second full term. A former Alameda city councilmember and East Bay assemblymember, he has made lawsuits against the Trump administration a central focus; his office marked its 100th such suit on October 15, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Bonta was born in Quezon City, Philippines, and immigrated to California with his family as an infant.
He attended public school in California and earned a Juris Doctor from Yale Law School.
He worked in private practice and then as a deputy city attorney for the City and County of San Francisco.
He later served on the Alameda City Council and spent more than eight years in the California State Assembly.
Gov. Gavin Newsom appointed him Attorney General, and he was sworn in on April 23, 2021, becoming the first person of Filipino descent to hold the office; he was elected to the post in 2022.
